title: 2 years of solo dev progress. Built with passion. AI helped along the way, but learning to use it properly was the real reward. Here my progress.
author: egod

comments.author: Imaginary-Insect9510
comments.body: I like the art style of your game. How did you use AI in your workflow?

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
the animations (skeletal?) look non-professional but they are working for the style you are going for

the game gives me those old-school flash game vibes. Good job on that

I also noticed you have 4k subscribers, wow.

I think your project will probably do well if you keep it up.

replies.author: egod
replies.body: Thank you. Yes the animations are hand-made. (No AI) It's funny I am also agree it give some charm to the game. I tried AI for animations but the game feel different. So I decide to keep my movement style. Good catch

comments.author: Donjuante
comments.body:
I know it’s not as simple as throwing it into GPT like I did, but it helps show the more aggressive and fantastical style I imagine for an RPG. I think the visuals need improvement . Everything feels a bit outdated and lifeless, with very flat colors. The rocks and bushes barely stand out and feel repetitive, the tree movement looks a bit artificial, and the player’s colder tones clash with the warmer NPC colors in a way that feels inconsistent to me.

replies.author: egod
replies.body: Ya, visual can be improved. Agree
